subject: reading
prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
passage: Bees visit flowers to drink nectar. As they move from flower to flower, pollen sticks to their legs. This pollen helps new seeds and fruits to grow.

Flowers are all the same color.

subject: reading
prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

subject: reading
prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

subject: reading

subject: reading
prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

subject: reading
prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

subject: reading
prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

subject: reading
